summary: Nez Perce NF log-cabin lookout near Elk City; built 1919 or 1923 (sources disagree), abandoned 1942, listed gone; no source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Listed as Gone by the Forest Fire Lookout Association; sources say the cabin was abandoned in 1942 and do not describe what remains

staffing.status: known staff: Adolph Weholt (1907), Mr. & Mrs. M.W. McLaughlin (1924)

visit.trail_note: Idaho Fire Lookouts labels the site drive-up; no current access rule or trail description found in the sources read

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Forest Service list and fact sheet date the log cabin with cupola to 1919; firelookout.com, Idaho Fire Lookouts and Kresek (via the Forest Lookouts page) give 1923. The story reports both dates and does not pick one.
Idaho Fire Lookouts lists a 1907 staff member, which is earlier than every build date in these sources. The page does not explain the gap, so the story reports the 1907 name as listed.

notes_for_editor: Build year disputed (1919 vs 1923). Do not confuse with the standing Camas County Iron Mountain at 43.53827, -115.04492 (NHLR US 1439, ID 131), or the Curry County, Oregon, site on firetower.org. Brief record matches the listing row (45.96814, -115.54188, Ground, Gone). No source found describes the site today. Access level not set: only the drive-up label is documented.
